# Slasher: Monsieur
[color=#ac3a0d]"Fucking Diabolical."[/color]
Monsieur is a prestige kit - ascend (reach 15 souls) as [bold]Billy[/bold] to unlock it. It keeps the full Slasher toolkit and adds one signature tool: a tentacle arm that reels victims in.
## What's different
- [bold]Tentacle Hook.[/bold] Launch a tentacle at a target and drag them straight to you. It grabs anything with a body, hits from a long way off, and briefly slows whatever it catches.
[italic]Range: 15 tiles. Cooldown: 30 seconds.[/italic]
